user.title: User Profile
user.description: User account information and system role.

uid.description: The unique user ID from Firebase Authentication.

email.description: The email address of the user.

displayName.description: The display name of the user.

role.description: The security role determining app access levels.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was generated.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was last updated.

inventoryItem.title: Inventory Item SKU
inventoryItem.description: Item of stock in the beads shop, including quantity and picture.

sku.description: The unique Stock Keeping Unit identifier (e.g., SKU-BEAD-RED-01).

name.description: The descriptive name of the bead item.

description.description: Details about size, materials, or style of the bead.

category.description: Bead category (e.g., Glass, Seed, Acrylic, Wooden, Pearl, Crystal).

imageUrl.description: Base64 encoded photo or illustration URL for the inventory SKU.

lastUpdatedBy.description: User email or ID who last edited this item.

invoiceNumber.description: Auto-incremented or unique sequential invoice number (e.g., INV-1001).

customerPhone.description: The contact number of the purchaser.

items.description: Array of sold SKU objects with price, name, quantity, and imageUrl.

totalAmount.description: Total bill of items included in the invoice.

paymentStatus.description: Current collection state of the invoice.

paymentMethod.description: Method chosen by client (e.g. GCash, Bank Transfer, Cash).

createdById.description: User UID who generated this invoice.

createdByEmail.description: User email who generated this invoice.

shippingStatus.description: The shipment delivery phase of the order.

invoiceStatus.description: The processing status of the invoice record.

description.description: Custom comments or description for the invoice.

shopSettings.title: Invoice Shop Settings
shopSettings.description: Shop details and templates for copyable scripts or payment data.

chatTemplate.description: Customizable text script template for sharing with customers.

notes.description: Optional background info or preferences notes.

/users/{userId}.description: Individual profiles and core database roles.

/inventory/{itemId}.description: Item listings in the beads shop.

/settings/{settingsId}.description: Global settings for the beads shop.

/customers/{customerId}.description: Bead shop customer records for loyalty and ledger tracking.
